title: Rewind-Phase Configuration Invariant
statement: Let $x$ be a binary word. For every natural number $i\le |x|$, after $i$ steps from state $1$ with the input head at position $i$, all bits of $x$ copied onto the work tape, and the work head at cell $|x|$, the three-state palindrome machine is in state $1$ with its input head at position $0$. The work tape and work-head position are unchanged, and the output remains empty.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary word of length $n$. For every $i \le n$, running the
three-state palindrome machine for $i$ steps from the rewind-state configuration
on input $x$ with input head at cell $i$, all $n$ bits copied, and work head at
cell $n$ brings the input head to the left boundary cell $0$, with the state,
work tape, and work head unchanged.
